E224.collision_check: repo-wide grep for 15243000 returned 0 hits before registration; disjoint from every band in _bands_used

E225.result: god-mode NOT A COUNTER: full arm -2,071/seat vs cha22 (CI -2,393..-1,765, 0W/24L, 12/12 worlds negative) and -1,636 vs topup7 (CI -2,015..-1,274, 0W/24L, 12/12). Bare spine worse than full, so the overlay helps them (+215/+271) but cannot close ~2k. Ported onto our spines it is -331 on cha22 (CI -540..-130) and +86 unresolved on topup7. No threat, no port. See GODSMODE_COUNTER_20260928/E225_VERDICT_20260928.md

E263.purpose: Base + panel restoration track (NO games run, NO submit). Pre-registers the fresh seed band for the first V4 field gate run on the re-derived 6-lineage out-of-fleet base panel. Registered BEFORE any game so the band cannot be chosen after seeing results.
E263.estimator: absolute-field (Kaggriculture.md s24 disclosure block; s27 V4). This is a preparation record: zero games have been played on this band.

Disjoint from the 15243000+1117*i family for ALL i (not just the consumed indices 0-3, 11-15, 15-23), from the operator-reserved 41700101-41700110, and from every band in _bands_used.
E263.design: s27 V4: 6 out-of-fleet lineages x 8 unseen seeds x both seat orders = 96 games per arm, collapsed to 48 distinct (opp, seed) worlds; paired within-world absolute bank delta. Metric is candidate bank - parent bank on the same world, plus the absolute level.

E263.arms: supplied on the command line; pre-flight audited vs BOTH arms by tools/h081_lineage_audit.py

E264.purpose: Operator-requested round-robin dominance matrix across the SLUICE family, cha22_champion and the tetsutani line (screen, not a promotion gate)
E264.collision_check: tools/seed_collision_check.py run in background; targeted grep of tools/ and experiments/ for all 3 literals = 0 hits; band outside every RESERVED range (60000000+1000*64=60064000 < 66100000)
E264.design: 5 agents x 10 unordered pairs x 3 seeds x both seat orders = 60 games; engine 1.32.7 pin asserted per worker; per-game CSV at FLEET_MATRIX_20260929/e264_per_game.csv
E264.power_note: 3 seeds/pair = 20 games total per agent; ranking screen only, below the noise budget a promotion gate needs
E264.result: 60/60 OK. Collapsed standings: tetsutani_step1009 (= what submission.py executes, its godview_v2 wrapper proven inert again: crop=0, effective preempt rewrites=0, 3/3 exact ties vs its own parent) 3W/0L +2178 sum-pair-mean > sluice_v8_counterd -1105 > sluice_topup7 -1540 > cha22_champion -1711 (0W/4L). See results/E264_FLEET_MATRIX_20260929.md

E265.purpose: Operator-requested GLOBAL LOCAL LEADERBOARD: absolute-field rank of every strong candidate we have or pulled, on one common out-of-fleet panel
E265.design: 21 arms x 6 panel lineages x 3 seeds x both seat orders = 756 games; every arm on the IDENTICAL (opp,seed,swap) grid so between-arm bank deltas are paired; metric = mean bank/seat + win% vs the common field + paired arm-minus-arm deltas with bootstrap CI. Run as 4 strided shards (arms[i::4]) in parallel.
E265.h081: panel audited out-of-fleet vs all 21 arms before any number is quoted

E266.purpose: H2H matrix: pulled external kernels leoprovorov/a-song-of-ice-and-fire-fixed-flexible + evgendvorkin/kaggriculture-version-31-26-09-bronze-going-up vs our tetsutani submission line (step1009, godview_v2==submission.py, cha22_e261_step1010) and the cha22_champion bar
E266.collision_check: RESOLVED COLLISION-FREE at registration. Reserved-range check PASS (88230000 lies in none of the 12 RESERVED ranges); path-scoped literal scans of experiments/ tools/ agents/ knowledge/ results/ LOCAL_LEADERBOARD_20260929/ all clean. The repo-wide seed_collision_check.py walk had NOT finished when games launched, and when it later completed it printed COLLISION-FREE: NO - that verdict is self-referential: an untruncated re-scan put all 71 hit locations in the 5 files this experiment itself wrote after the scan started (per_game.csv 54, LEO_EVGEN_20260930_collision.log 14 = the checker reading its own stdout, seeds.json 6 = this E266 entry, matrix.log 3, results/E266 doc 1). No pre-existing file contains any of the three seeds. Tool defects recorded in results/E266_LEO_EVGEN_H2H_20260930.md section 5: the checker self-excludes only __file__, and truncates the hit list to 5 per seed so a 6th occurrence is invisible in the verdict.
E266.design: 9 candidate-involving pairs x 3 seeds x both seat orders = 54 games; tetsutani-internal pairs skipped (on record in E264/E253); engine 1.32.7 + townCenterSellInterval=24 asserted per worker; per-game CSV + separate aggregator
E266.result: both pulled externals lose every pair: leo -1,508.7..-2,375.3/seat 0W/12L, evgen -4,046.2..-5,020.5/seat 0W/15L vs all four of our files; leo beat evgen +4,372.5 3W/0L. 54/54 OK, 719 steps, pin 1.32.7, 472s. No counter, no port. Standings order is a sum-of-pair-means artifact (cha22 vs tetsutani not played here; E264 has cha22 -440.3). Absolute-field estimator NOT run. See results/E266_LEO_EVGEN_H2H_20260930.md
